rca of the issue: Prior bug: the daily-drop useEffect ran with wallet=null during the JWT-hydration window and set the fired-ref such that when hydration completed with a real identity, the effect exited early. Main agent's fix added `if (hydrating) return;` guard BEFORE setting dropFiredForIdentityRef, plus explicit logging. Reproduced flow confirms: two initial renders skip while hydrating=true, then a third render with a real identity fires the fetch and receives 200. Bug resolved.
